all.src: Strike = the strike nearest spot at entry, |delta| 0.45-0.55.
Net debit <= 1% of equity per unit; maximum 2 earnings calendars open at once.

exits.src: If the front leg is 0DTE the morning after, the 14:30 ET forced-close rule applies as a hard backstop, but the trade should already be flat by 10:30.
Close the short leg immediately if it goes ITM with extrinsic <= $0.05 - a post-earnings ITM short is an assignment candidate the same day.

unexpressed.text: Confirmed earnings date and confirmed that the front expiry contains it and the back expiry contains no second event.

unexpressed.text: front_IV - back_IV >= 8.0 vol points at the ATM strike.

unexpressed.text: Front-month implied move (ATM straddle / spot) <= 8%; skip anything above.
Historical check: over the last 8 prints, the median |actual move| must be < 0.8 x the current implied move.
Enter in the last 60 minutes of the session BEFORE the print (between 15:00 and 15:50 ET), never days early - the front IV ramp is the payment.
